transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’m a terrible person and that everything that’s gone wrong is my fault, like I’ve already messed up my whole life. My pastor and my aunt really insisted I come in because I've been struggling so much lately.
Have you ever had periods in your life where you felt the exact opposite—unusually high, full of energy, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've never had times where I felt really high or full of energy; it's mostly just been the opposite, where I feel completely exhausted and weighed down.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this depressed and exhausted in the past, or is this the very first time you have felt this way?

No, this is the very first time I've ever felt like this. It all started about fourteen months ago when I began pushing myself too hard with my GED prep and working extra shifts. Before that, I had never experienced anything this dark or exhausting.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in the things you used to enjoy doing?

Yes, I really have. Things I used to love, like going to Zumba or helping at the youth center, just feel so pointless and far away now. It honestly feels like I’m just watching my life from underwater.
How has your sleep been during this time? Are you having trouble falling asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping too much?

My sleep has been terrible. I lie in bed for hours unable to fall asleep because my mind keeps replaying all my mistakes, and then I wake up around 3:00 or 4:00 AM with my heart racing. I can't get back to sleep after that, so I'm just completely exhausted.
When we feel this low and exhausted, it's not uncommon to have thoughts about giving up. Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or that life is no longer worth living?

Yes, almost every day I catch myself thinking it would be better if I just didn't wake up. On the worst nights, I've sat on my bed holding my old pain pills, planning how many it would take so I could finally stop being a burden to everyone.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight since this started, such as losing interest in food or losing weight without trying?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or weight. It's been so hard to find the energy to cook lately that my aunt has to bring me food, so I'm not entirely sure.
Sometimes when people feel extremely down, they might hear or see things that others don't, or have strong beliefs that others tell them aren't real. Have you experienced anything like that?

It's really hard to admit, but late at night I hear a man's voice right behind my left ear telling me I'm worthless, have disappointed God, and that something bad will happen to my family. I also have this deep belief that God has cursed me for my failures, and it feels like everyone at work, school, and church can see it on me.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with her first lifetime episode of severe depression, lasting 14 months, characterized by depressed mood, anhedonia, profound exhaustion, severe insomnia, and active suicidal ideation with a specific plan (holding pain pills). Additionally, she exhibits mood-congruent psychotic features, including auditory hallucinations (a voice telling her she is worthless and has disappointed God) and delusions of guilt/punishment (believing God has cursed her and others can see it). There is no history of manic or hypomanic episodes, which rules out bipolar disorder, and the psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during the depressive episode, ruling out primary schizophrenia.
